label: Wave 3 reconciliation (lane REC3): the lanes' commands re-run on the merged tree, BEFORE THE FIX LANE. Simulated worlds of fictional software releases through the real modules; offline; no model. Not the open web.
measured_on: f0a1f09 (genesis-wave3, all six Wave 3 lanes merged), clean tree, aarch64, Python 3.12.16
before_the_fix_lane: At f0a1f09 lane S's attribution_independence and echo_recognition were ON by default. The main session has since decided both ship OFF (measurement review S-1..S-8; security review H1, M2-M5); the fix lane re-measures after that default change. These figures record how the lanes met, not the shipped product after Wave 3.
withheld: never run, read or imported by name here; importing the cognition package (as every harness does) imports withheld.py indirectly, nothing of it used

cognitive_benchmark.command: PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/bench_cognition.py run --split <development|held_out> --out <file> (every family but withheld, mechanism baseline, shipped settings of f0a1f09)

scope.plant: simulated: the constants (CONSTANTS: task memory, task length, breach lines) are declared by the benchmark, not measured on the host
scope.wiring: the regulator is called directly with the plant's history; the product's wiring (the gate resources.policy.background_gate, the history file <db>.resources/internal-state.jsonl and the worker's sampler internal_state.record) is not exercised by this family; tests/test_predictive_wiring.py drives it end to end on a staged individual
scope.reading: a gain here is a gain inside this plant; for lane I's forecaster on held-out it comes from reserving memory per background task (removing the trend leaves all of it there; on development the trend matters more: scripts/bench_wave1.py ablations, trend_share_of_avoided)
